items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1972-01-19
items.q: Shoyman I think, no, no, that man's name is not Shoyman.

ctx.x: That's the Hot Five things. Right.

Taken from that section. That's why we took the house that night. So that little fella by the name, he used to be like a floor walker for the Pelican. He went back up to New York. He said, I'm trying to make the review of it, I can't think of them guys' names. But anyhow, he had to go, Shoyman I think, no, no, that man's name is not Shoyman. But he had to get on the floor and beg the people to stop playing, get a lot of other bands a chance to play.
When they finally let them play there?
